svg.aria-label: Escalation ladder from worker to control session to parent to human, with the give-up rule at each rung
svg.text: Worker
implements; may not rule
Control session, arbiter L1
rules alone or convenes a council
Parent control, arbiter L2 .. root
same steps, wider scope
Human
decision packet in; binding case out
GIVE-UP RULE TO REACH THIS RUNG
Council failed, or authority reserved to the human: spend, external
commitments, data deletion, epic scope, hook-marked human-only, or the
ruling would overrule a human case.
Council failed (no quorum, or an unrefuted blocking dissent), or the
question crosses the work unit boundary: other worktrees, shared
interfaces, epic acceptance criteria, budget.
Blocker reproduced; at least two distinct attempts logged with outcomes;
case law queried; question typed with options. Immediate if outside
worker authority: scope, interface, irreversible action, security.
AT EVERY ARBITER
1 empirical: probe 2 fresh binding precedent: cite 3 no council trigger: rule alone 4 else council
An escalation with no proposed ruling is sent back down. Unpicked escalations move up after a timeout, with a cap.
